newsitem.title: USA: No semen found at JonBenet crime scene.
newsitem.headline: No semen found at JonBenet crime scene.

text.p: Police investigating the murder of six-year-old beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey found no semen at the crime scene, The Denver Post reported Saturday.
It said that although the girl was sexually assaulted, semen was not found at or near the body, in the girl's bedroom or in the basement where her body was found Dec. 26.
Authorities have not said if the girl was sexually assaulted at the time of the murder, but a partially disclosed autopsy report said she had abrasions on her vagina.
No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the probe. A veteran detective who has worked on more than 150 homicide cases joined the district attorney's task force this week.
The girl's body was found by her father John Ramsey some eight hours after her mother Patricia said she found a ramson note demanding $118,000.
